summary: TFI International filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing it will report third-quarter 2026 financial results on October 29, 2026, after market close, followed by a 5:00 PM Eastern webcast hosted by Chairman/President/CEO Alain Bédard and CFO David Saperstein. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory element appears. This is a routine earnings-calendar notice for the NYSE/TSX-listed trucking and logistics registrant, not a special situation; watch only for quarterly results and any subsequent M&A commentary, which would be the actual catalyst.
